key_reasoning.reason: Two new modules (tool_call_channel backend poller with exec runner and handler registry, and the standalone runtime SDK) plus edits to sandbox_guard (SDK bootstrap injection), session_manager, code_executor_tool, execute_workspace_script_tool, agent_workspace_service and the customer-config component. New abstractions (ExecRunner protocol, handler registry, file-based request/response protocol) span several subsystems.

No exact precedent: a file-based request/response bridge between a sandboxed script and the backend over Kubernetes exec, with polling, retries, exec timeouts, payload caps, oversize and bad-encoding handling, pod-side pid/start_time markers and a threaded channel lifecycle. It sits inside the sandbox guard (security-sensitive: SDK executed in guarded exec, filesystem policy interplay). The enumerated edge and error cases were covered by dedicated test files, and a review round (10 findings) and one live-verification bug (pod name) confirm the risk.

22 files changed (3330 insertions, 25 deletions): 12 source, config and README files and 8 test files, including new modules and new test files, across src/codemie, src/codemie_tools, config, tests and tooling. 3 files are unrelated tooling (.gitleaks.toml, run-local-sonar.js, tests/conftest.py); even excluding them the count stays at 16 or more, XXL per the diffstat mapping.
